q: Which four main topics structure the People chapter?
a: Context; leading successful change; leading successful teams; communication.

q: What is the difference between Leadership and Management?
a: Management is about processes and control; Leadership is about motivation, vision, and guiding people.
Organizational Change Management: guiding people through changes in habits and attitudes so that they accept the new situation.
An environment where people can raise concerns, ask questions and report mistakes without fear of blame.

q: Which document defines the rules for exchanging information with stakeholders?
a: The communication management approach, part of the project initiation documentation.

q: Why was People added in the 7th edition of PRINCE2?
a: People working on and affected by a project are essential to delivering and embedding its outcomes.

q: Does OCM concern only the project team?
a: No. It concerns all stakeholders and end users affected by the change.

q: Who is responsible for building the right culture in the project team?
a: Leaders throughout the project shape the culture, with the project manager and team managers playing key roles.
